traceability.specification: Trace every accepted requirement and criterion to applicable Scryer claims, real implementation anchors, a verification method and executed evidence. Do not invent claims or label configured/attached tests as passing executions.

Extend whole-state convergence coverage beyond database size: valid keys, temporary/replacement state, runs, retired generations, tombstones, legacy staging and Direct retirement. Use an isolated clean-control fixture with the same final source state.

Proposed churn qualification: 20 supported source updates plus failures, unchanged refreshes and repeated maintenance. At verified idle, retain one active generation, current cache and necessary coordination files, with no known collectible residue. Blocked foreign/unknown state must be reported and excluded from a successful clean-state claim.
Prove graph/search/context equivalence and preservation of unchanged artifact reuse. Compare expected reachable content, not only counts or empty directories.

Exercise process death at temporary-write, replacement, publication, detachment and deletion boundaries; reader/writer contention; cancellation; permissions failures; stale inventory; missing/corrupt authority; symlink/foreign paths; historical helper ownership; and retries without new edits. Faults control only fixture-owned processes.

Use existing native CI platform gates and lifecycle profiles. Local macOS observations, extracted-function checks, default compilation, native Windows qualification and aggregate closure remain separate evidence. New required regressions run normally, without ignore or expected-failure treatment.

Before any implementation, obtain the repository-required fresh GPT-6.1 Sol Max proposal review and resolve decision-blocking findings. Before completion, obtain the required fresh final integrated review, fix every confirmed P0–P3 defect, and reverify affected paths. This specification turn does not claim either implementation gate is complete.

Record exact source revision, binary/environment identity, commands, JUnit evidence, outcomes and limitations. Complete required formatting/build/static/test checks without unresolved compiler warnings, then reconcile Scryer and wiki outcomes.

Rollout requires a compatible verified binary/helper set and truthful inventory before collection. Selection of installation/restart/live migration actions is validated separately with the actual operational context. Specification preparation neither updates an old daemon nor deletes this installation's data.
Given the same final source workload, when churn and clean-control builds reach verified idle, then the collector leaves only allowed state and equivalent graph behavior.
